records.premise: Fixed reference commit, valid ordinary Pokemon/player/Pokedex/Bag and declared caller values. Reached prior host, message, media, animation and data steps return normally unless the failure prefix is stated. No external hook/plugin assumed; no business execution.

child_assertions.meaning: All five wrappers delegate the same individual to check_evolution_internal, adding only their own family callback and actual item/other Pokemon/party index/event value; event value defaults 0.
Common short circuit order is egg? OR shadowPokemon?, then hasItem(EVERSTONE), then hasAbility(BATTLEBOND); any match returns nil before callback scanning.
Current species_data.get_evolutions(true) supplies ordered current species/form forward triples; Species removes prevolution and None before the redundant evo[3] guard.

The first truthy callback outcome maps to its corresponding target symbol; later entries are not tested. An absent family proc returns false via its registry call wrapper rather than promoting after-action-only Shedinja.

The callbacks do not commit species/EXP/moves. Guard/predicate getters can fill derived caches, while EventAfterDamageTaken is the explicit domain write to ready_to_evolve; no all-bytes-unchanged claim.

records.label: MINIMUM_LEVEL_FAMILY
records.premise: Fixed reference commit, valid ordinary Pokemon/player/Pokedex/Bag and declared caller values. Reached prior host, message, media, animation and data steps return normally unless the failure prefix is stated. No external hook/plugin assumed; no business execution.

child_assertions.meaning: Minimum level is 1 with no relations/no selected reverse relation; it consumes the first reverse prevolution selected by the compiler, rather than reselecting all candidate parents.
It resolves prevo species with this base_form and returns 1 if that prevo has nonnil incense, before recursing to its minimum.
When method lacks level_up_proc and is not Shedinja it returns prevo minimum; otherwise any_level_up truthy gives prevo minimum+1, else the literal parameter.
This query is not a guard inside the five check wrappers. Legal acyclic inputs are the scope; recursive family/baby/minimum queries do not establish arbitrary-cycle termination.
Family enumeration sorts targets by registry key order; get_evolutions preserves authored order. Family include-None queries and runtime exclude-None queries are different consumers.
Baby-species walks the selected first reverse relation and optional incense items; egg-move fallback uses that prevo and current form, not a merge of every possible ancestral branch.

pbEvolution performs initial text/decision/old cry and one-second update wait before Evolution start ME and Evolution BGM; only its later animation loop tests BACK && cancancel.
On accepted BACK it stops BGM, plays cancel SE and breaks with canceled=true; flash/reset runs before cancellation statistic/message.

child_assertions.meaning: Success first increments evolution_count, obtains new-species cry length with the individual current form, plays cry, waits, stops BGM, plays success ME and shows congratulations using old display name and new species name.
After-action scan runs before original species mutation. A failure in presentation can leave success count incremented while neither after-actions nor model commit occurred.
After actions, success records old fainted state, sets species, writes hp=0 if old fainted, explicitly calc_stats again and clears ready_to_evolve.
It then snapshots was_owned, registers the actual mutated individual and sets new species owned, before collecting new level0/current-level moves in their ordered learning list.

With no pending moves that Dex path calls pbEndScreen(false) early; otherwise moves each pass general pbLearnMove(...,true), whose refusal affects that move only. Caller still contains its own final EndScreen; host repeat disposal is not guaranteed.

At maximum it computes level-family target, then requires RARE_CANDY_USABLE_AT_MAX_LEVEL and target. Failure shows no-effect and false; successful candidate uses cancellable default Evolution, EndScreen, optional refresh, then true even when canceled.
